page.layout: One page of running text, no marginal notes. Running head at top right above the text. Page number at top right. Catchword at lower right and gathering signature at lower centre, both below the last line.

main_text.p: Narretur per hypothesin, consuetudo ieiunii quadragesimalis ante Pascha. 1. vetus: & ostendatur ejus varietas in numero dierum & ciborum abstinentia ex Socrat. lib.5.cap.21. Et Sozom. lib. 7.cap.19.
main_text.l: 3. Modus: abstinentia à cibis pontificia lege prohibiti.
4. Finis: satisfactio pro furore Bacchanaliū, & expiatio aliorum peccatorum.
main_text.p: Ratio 1. Quia non sit à Deo præceptum, sed inventum merè humanum.
Probetur testimonio Pontificiorum, quorum alii Telesphorum, alii Melchiaden, alii Montanum, alii alios authores faciunt.

Ratio II. Quia prohibitio certorum ciborum sine expresso Dei mandato pugnat cum doctrina & libertate Evangelica. Col.2.16: Ne quis vos iudicet. 1.Cor.7.23. Ne fiatis servi hominum. Tit.1.15. Omnia munda mundis. 1.Tim.4.1. Doctrina dæmoniorum.
Ratio III. Quia fictitii cultus & conscientiarum torturæ non sunt feredæ in Ecclesia Christiana. Matth.15.9: Frustra me colunt. Col.2.16: Ne quis vos iudicet ob cibum, &c.
Minoris probatio sumatur ex definitione cultus Dei: & experientia: quæ probetur Hymno:

page.notes: The first line begins mid-word; the initial "h" of "his" is cut off by the gutter, so it is left as a fragment. The printed "Ratio II." and "Ratio III." are set as "II." and "III." Long s is transcribed as s throughout. Scan is faint in places but all lines are legible. No marginal notes, no woodcut initials, no stamps on the printed page. The "N" of "Narretur" is a decorative initial and is joined to the word.
